descriptions.Switch / Checkbox: Applying a setting at once versus collecting consent or list choices.
descriptions.Radio Group / Checkbox: Choosing exactly one versus choosing any number.
descriptions.Tabs / Segmented Control: Switching content panels versus picking a mode or value on the same screen.
descriptions.Modal Dialog / Bottom Sheet: Getting a decision in the middle of the screen versus offering quick actions from the bottom.
descriptions.Chip / Badge: Conditions or attributes people can select and remove versus a mark that reads a state or count.
descriptions.Spinner / Skeleton: Quietly signaling work in progress versus filling an area whose layout is known.
descriptions.Number Stepper / Slider: Adjusting precisely in fixed steps versus picking a value in a range quickly.
descriptions.Hamburger / Kebab: The menu for the whole site versus extra actions for the current item.
descriptions.Kebab / Meatballs: Vertical and horizontal marks for the same extra actions; what matters is consistency across platforms and layouts.
descriptions.Share / Export: Passing something to another person or app versus producing a file in a separate format.
descriptions.Close / Back: Ending a floating window versus returning to a navigation step you visited.
descriptions.Refresh / Undo: Fetching the latest data again versus canceling the last action.
descriptions.Search / Zoom In: Finding content versus seeing the current target larger.
descriptions.Filter / Sort: Changing which items are in the results versus changing their order.
descriptions.Edit / Compose: Changing an existing item versus writing a new one.
descriptions.Dropdown / Picker: Opening a short list of options versus using a dedicated chooser for things like dates and times.
descriptions.Carousel / Horizontal Scroll: Moving item by item versus freely browsing content that runs sideways.
descriptions.Top Bar / Bottom Tab Bar: Holding the screen title and its actions versus switching between the app's main destinations.
descriptions.Pagination / Infinite Scroll: Returning to a specific place later versus loading more as people keep reading.
descriptions.Floating Action Button / Sticky Action B: Floating one main action versus pinning buttons and a summary together at the bottom.
descriptions.Progress Bar / Step Indicator: Showing a continuous share of completion versus showing the current one of several named steps.
descriptions.Accordion / Read More: Opening one of several titled sections versus expanding a single long text.
descriptions.Placeholder / Label: Showing a format example while a field is empty versus naming the field even after input.
descriptions.Helper Text / Error Message: Explaining the rules before input versus saying what to fix before submitting.
descriptions.Text Field / Textarea: Taking a short name or number versus taking paragraphs and line breaks.
descriptions.Autocomplete / Search Suggestion: Completing the query being typed versus suggesting related or popular searches.
descriptions.Password / OTP: Entering a secret used again and again versus a one-time code.
descriptions.Clear / Show Password: Emptying the input versus changing how the kept value is shown.
descriptions.Character Counter / Max Length: Telling the current length versus enforcing the allowed length.
descriptions.Numeric Keypad / Keyboard: Taking mostly numbers versus taking letters and symbols.
descriptions.Date Input / Date Picker: Typing a date you already know versus browsing the dates you can choose.
descriptions.Required / Optional: Information needed to submit versus information people can skip.
descriptions.Alert / Confirmation Dialog: Making sure people notice and acknowledge something versus asking them to proceed or cancel.
descriptions.Non-modal Popup / Modal Dialog: A small window that lets people keep using the page versus one that blocks the background until they respond. What "popup" covers depends on context.
descriptions.Toast / Snackbar: In this catalog: a short result message versus the variant with an action such as undo.
descriptions.Tooltip / Popover: A short supporting hint versus a panel that can hold links and buttons.
descriptions.Bottom Sheet / Drawer: A task panel at the bottom of the screen versus a navigation or task panel opened from the side.
descriptions.Alert Banner / Push Notification: Informing people while they use the site or app versus reaching them through the system notification area.
descriptions.Badge / Notification Dot: When there is a count to show versus only signaling that something needs a look.
descriptions.Onboarding / Coach Mark: Walking through the service at the start versus pointing at a specific element on the current screen.
descriptions.Dim / Blur: Lowering the background's brightness versus lowering its sharpness.
descriptions.Alert Dialog / Toast: A message that needs confirming versus a short one that lets people carry on.
descriptions.Like / Wishlist: Reacting to content versus collecting products you are interested in.
descriptions.Wishlist / Cart: Products to look at again later versus products you may pay for now.
descriptions.Bookmark / Like: A bookmark that keeps items to see later for yourself versus a heart that leaves a reaction.
descriptions.Follow / Subscribe to Notifications: Collecting new posts in a feed versus choosing when to get updates.
descriptions.Share / Copy Link: Letting people choose who to send to versus putting the address on the clipboard.
descriptions.Rating / Review: Getting a quick score versus getting a written account of the experience.
descriptions.Recently Viewed / Wishlist: A record of what you opened versus items you chose to collect.
descriptions.Like / Reaction: One positive response versus one of several feelings.
descriptions.Save / Download: Keeping something in the app's list versus downloading a copy of the file to the device.
